title: 第七章 祸端第章 启程第九章 家书
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
周青梅说晕就晕，倒是让方书文猝不及防。
赶紧将她接住，目光环视一圈，周青梅和那黑袍人交手，已经脱离了湖心小筑的范围。
他便抱着周青梅，朝着湖心小筑走去。
只是临走之前，又在那黑袍人的脑袋上补了一脚。
过去看小说的时候，他就对不补刀的行为深恶痛绝。
打蛇不死反受其害，方书文可不想留下什么后患。
湖心小筑是一处湖心岛，湖心岛不大，往外是通过一座木桥连接。
抱着周青梅进了湖心小筑，这里清幽寂静。
寻了一个房间，将她安置好之后，他就开始翻箱倒柜的寻找药物。
周青梅内外伤皆有，内伤需得以内功帮她调理，外伤的话，得赶紧给她找药止血包扎。
否则，内伤好了，流血也流死她了。
方书文终究是在药铺里做了六七年打杂的，虽然没有正经的学过医术，但耳濡目染之下，找点止血生肌的药，还是不难的。
运气比较好，止血生肌的药材他没找到，倒是找到了现成的金疮药。
只是看着躺在榻上的周青梅，又有点犯难。
不过他只是犹豫了不到三秒，就开始去解她腰间玉带。
性命攸关的事情，再考虑可就矫情了。
而且这地方也没有拿着手机的吃瓜群众，不担心被人发到网上网暴。
给她上好了金疮药，包扎了伤口。
又将她的衣服穿好，这才将她从榻上搀扶起来，让她盘膝而坐。
他自己则坐在了周青梅身后，运起【易筋经】神功，一掌按在了她的后背上。

【易筋经】神功奥妙通玄，本身就有疗伤之能。
方书文通篇理解此篇功法，其中手段也是信手拈来。
周青梅所受内力似乎有些古怪，不过和【易筋经】神功一碰，便好似春雪遇骄阳，刹那间消失无踪。
如此过了一炷香的功夫，他收回内息，将周青梅放平让她休息，自己则出了房门，坐在门外守着。
这一守就是足足一夜。
周青梅睁开双眼的时候，已然是东方微熹，晨光自窗户撒进房间之内。
若不是外伤的疼痛时不时传入心头，倒还真的有几分岁月静好的味道。
她自床上起身，发出了一声闷哼。
看了看身上包扎的细布，微微蹙眉。
环顾房间，不见方书文的踪迹，便自榻上下来，缓步来到门前，推开房门，就见方书文正席地盘膝而坐，似乎在修炼内功。
周青梅一时之间不知道该不该惊扰，就听方书文轻声说道
“感觉如何？”
周青梅稍微运转内息，眸中泛起一抹异色
“内伤已经无碍了。
“是你帮我运功疗伤，给我包扎的？”
“这湖心小筑也没有第三个人了。”
方书文翻身起来，转回头笑道
“大小姐是介意我给你包扎，还是介意我给你运功疗伤？”
他这态度有些混不吝，周青梅对这样的人素来不假辞色。
可如今不知怎的，倒是生不出厌恶的念头，轻轻抿了抿唇角

“我们走。”
“去哪？”
在方书文一愣。
“回家。”
content_en:
Zhou Qingmei fainted immediately, but Fang Shuwen was caught off guard.
He quickly caught her and looked around. Zhou Qingmei had fought with the black-robed man and was out of the range of the small building in the center of the lake.
He hugged Zhou Qingmei and walked towards the small building in the middle of the lake.
But before leaving, he slapped the black-robed man on the head again.
When he read novels in the past, he hated the behavior of not finishing the last hit.
Fang Shuwen didn't want to leave any trouble if he beat the snake but didn't die.
The small building in the center of the lake is an island in the center of the lake. The island in the center of the lake is not big and is connected to the outside by a wooden bridge.
Carrying Zhou Qingmei into the small house in the middle of the lake, it was quiet and quiet.
After finding a room and settling her in, he began to rummage through the cabinets in search of medicine.
Zhou Qingmei had both internal and external injuries. Internal injuries needed to be treated with internal strength. For external injuries, she had to quickly find medicine to stop the bleeding and bandage her.
Otherwise, the internal injuries would heal, but the bleeding would kill her.
After all, Fang Shuwen had been working as a handyman in a drug store for six or seven years. Although he had never seriously studied medical skills, it was not difficult to find some medicine to stop bleeding and promote muscle building under the influence of his own experience.
Fortunately, he didn't find the medicine to stop bleeding and promote muscle growth, but he found the ready-made medicine for golden sores.
Just looking at Zhou Qingmei lying on the couch, she felt a little embarrassed.
However, he only hesitated for less than three seconds before starting to untie the jade belt around her waist.
It would be pretentious to think about it again when life is at stake.
Moreover, there are no people holding mobile phones in this place, so they don’t worry about being posted online.
He gave her the golden sore medicine and bandaged the wound.
He put her clothes on again, then helped her up from the couch and asked her to sit cross-legged.
He himself sat behind Zhou Qingmei, used the [Yi Jin Jing] magical skill, and pressed his palm on her back.
[Yi Jin Jing] The magical power is mysterious and has the ability to heal wounds.
Fang Shuwen understood the exercises throughout the article, and the methods were readily available.
The internal force Zhou Qingmei received seemed a little strange, but when it came into contact with the [Yi Jin Jing] magical power, it disappeared in an instant like spring snow meeting the scorching sun.
After a while of burning incense, he took back his breath, laid Zhou Qingmei down to let her rest, and then left the room and sat guarding outside.
This guarding lasted a full night.
When Zhou Qingmei opened her eyes, it was already dawn in the east, and the morning light poured into the room from the window.
If it weren't for the pain from the trauma that came into my heart from time to time, it would really feel like the peace of the years.
She stood up from the bed and let out a muffled groan.
He looked at the fine cloth wrapped around his body and frowned slightly.
Looking around the room, there was no trace of Fang Shuwen, so he got off the couch and walked slowly to the door. When he opened the door, he saw Fang Shuwen sitting cross-legged on the floor, seemingly practicing his internal skills.
Zhou Qingmei didn't know whether to disturb her for a moment, so she heard Fang Shuwen say softly.
"How does it feel?"
Zhou Qingmei circulated her inner breath a little, and there was a strange color in her eyes.
“The internal injuries are gone.
"Did you help me heal my injuries and bandage them? "
"There is no third person in this small house in the middle of the lake. "
Fang Shuwen stood up, turned around and smiled.
"Miss, do you mind if I bandage you, or do you mind if I perform exercises to heal your injuries? "
His attitude was a bit generous, and Zhou Qingmei had never been polite to such people.
But now for some reason, I can't think of disgust, and I lightly pursed my lips.
"Let's go. "
"Where to go? "
Zai Fang Shuwen was stunned.
"Go home. "
